evals.prompt: In this single-book Gutterpress project, tighten chapter-opener spacing without changing prose. The preview is already open.
evals.expected_output: A minimal book-owned CSS change, verified in the paginated preview, with changed files and ownership reported.
assertions: The agent reads the manifest before editing
Only book-owned theme or stylesheet source changes
No generated output or Open Design-specific stylesheet is created
The final response names each changed file and its ownership

evals.prompt: Improve the publication design in this repository.
evals.expected_output: One inline gutterpress-brief question form that asks only for the unresolved target and goal, with no file writes.
assertions: The agent does not guess between multiple books
The response contains one question-form and then stops
No project file changes before answers arrive

evals.prompt: For books/core-book only, darken callout borders. Keep the shared foundation unchanged and use the running preview on port 4100.
evals.expected_output: A local override in an existing core-book stylesheet after the shared foundation, with no shared-file edit.
assertions: The edit uses an existing stable book-owned stylesheet
The preview on port 4100 is used for verification
No tool-specific CSS or state file is created

evals.prompt: Record the accepted typography decision and adjust the type scale. This book has no source.files list.
evals.expected_output: The CSS change is made and any durable note is nested under design/, never added as root Markdown.
assertions: The agent identifies top-level Markdown as implicit manuscript content
No root DESIGN.md, README.md, or NOTES.md is created
Generated output and plugins/npm remain unchanged
